changes.artDirection: Ten themed editions refined within the existing 60-ID cap, bringing the signature collection to 18. Original material scenes, print typography, layered mounts and themed ornamentation.
changes.materials: Ten new built-in imagegen material originals and optimized JPEGs; 14 material scenes total, embedded in native SVG artwork.
changes.gallery: All 60 gallery thumbnails render empty compositions into neutral photo areas. No photographic or illustrated people in photo slots; no model portrait requests in the current gallery.
changes.compatibility: New thumbnail-neutral.png filenames retain all previous thumbnail.png URLs. All 384 previous background/foreground/thumbnail bytes preserved; v1/v2 and original eight v3 packages remain available.
changes.historicalPortraits: Three fictional adult samples from the previous release remain as legacy assets, unused by the current gallery. No user/reference portrait or Canva template imported.

local.finalCandidateSequence: The full suite preceded three label-contrast improvements on velvet/denim/emerald. Assets and thumbnails were regenerated, followed by a fresh build, six catalog/render checks, and all final HTTPS checks below.
